items.headline: Thomas and Arnold lead UNLV past Hawaii 21-6 to win fourth straight Island Showdown
items.description: — Jai'den Thomas rushed for 143 yards and a touchdown, Jackson Arnold rushed for 89 yards and two scores along with 116 passing yards, and UNLV weathered Hawaii's attempted comeback in a 21-6 victory on Saturday night.

items.headline: Memphis rallies to victory in Vegas, gives Huff winning debut
items.description: Marcus Stokes threw for two touchdowns as Memphis rallied to score the final 13 points to help Charles Huff become the first Tigers head coach to win a road debut game with a 27-21 victory over UNLV.

items.headline: Stokes' 2 TDs, Memphis' defensive line leads Tigers past UNLV 27-21
items.description: — Marcus Stokes threw for 223 yards and two touchdowns as Memphis rattled off the final 13 points to beat UNLV 27-21 on Saturday night in a season opener for both teams.

items.headline: TCU's shamrock frog helmets top best uniforms of CFB Week 0
items.description: TCU's lids mix the team's traditional purple color scheme with some locally themed flair -- the Horned Frog helmet emblem has a shamrock in its mouth.
